description: This file appears to be part of a Go project, defining functions and variables related to menu setup for a UI application using the Fyne library. It includes setting up menu items, enabling them, and building the main menu structure.

methods.name: InitMenuItems
methods.description: Initializes menu items for network name, channel change, and reset, disabling them initially.

methods.name: enableMenuItems
methods.description: Enables the menu items and triggers a menu redraw.

methods.name: BuildMainMenu
methods.description: Constructs and returns the main menu with 'Settings' and 'Help' options.
